suites.title: Native browser contract with intercepted API responses — PostgreSQL E2E remains separate

specs.title: ignores a persisted demo persona and requires actual API authentication
keeps a failed login form and retries the same intent before navigating on acknowledgement
accepts a new invitation only after a matching ACK and preserves the result after cache invalidation
requires the invited existing identity and does not offer a password replacement
keeps a reset draft after an invalid ACK and shows completion after authentication changes
retains a dirty profile and its reviewed version across background refresh and resolves conflict explicitly
allows an actual nullable own work phone and saves only after the server profile acknowledgement

suites.title: Native school browser contract — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: keeps school edits on a transient read failure and removes the private form on forbidden reads
accepts nullable public contacts and clears dirty state only after a matching profile ACK
opens a school without years and keeps year creation reachable
keeps a reviewed school profile through background refresh and reloads explicitly after conflict
creates a class with class authority alone, retains a wrong ACK and retries one atomic command
shows the year calendar with year authority alone and labels denied class data

suites.title: Native staff browser contracts — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: renders denied assignment and history panels without inventing empty data or reading invitations
keeps mixed action scopes and source version through refresh, retains read failures and reloads a role explicitly after conflict
creates an invitation through purpose-bound choices with zero roles and truthful queued delivery
replaces school roles with the reviewed member version and actual delegation deadline without reading a role catalog
saves the reviewed assignment dates and versions, retains a wrong ACK and manually retries the same key
recovers a handover after a lost create ACK and reload, then reviews changed sources without creating a second receipt

suites.title: Native student and guardian browser contracts — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: uses directory year and class choices, preserves denied counters and sends server filters
opens a class-write creation form without school, year or roster readers and creates atomically
renders the minimal subject projection without family, notes, positions or stored link credentials
renders existing link metadata without recovering a secret or borrowing issuance authority
retains the student draft and displayed version through background read failure and a wrong mutation ACK
uses the atomic guardian source, keeps masked contact unchanged and freezes all reviewed versions
requires an explicit receiving choice for verification and sends the clicked relationship version
removes an open guardian draft when purpose authority is revoked

suites.title: Native school support browser contracts — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: uses server ticket totals, message counts and filters without borrowing consent authority
keeps a ticket draft through read failure and mismatched create ACK, then manually retries the same intent
uses the reviewed support version through refresh and retains a required decline reason on conflict
retains an unconfirmed school message and sends the same key on manual retry
uses audit SQL filters and removes a private detail drawer when read authority is denied
